territorial_scope.description: A Brazilian regulator recognises named foreign jurisdictions (EU, EEA states and EU institutions) as adequate, governing transfers of personal data from Brazil to them.

evidence.quote: Fica reconhecida a União Europeia como organismo internacional que proporciona grau de proteção de dados pessoais adequado

summary.short: Recognises the European Union, its member states, the EEA states Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and EU institutions as providing an adequate level of personal data protection, so that international transfers may rely on LGPD Art. 33 I. Excludes transfers for public security, defence, state security and criminal investigation. Enters into force on publication.
summary.long: ANPD Resolução CD/ANPD nº 32 of 26 January 2026, published in the Diário Oficial da União on 27 January 2026, recognises the European Union as an international organisation providing an adequate level of personal data protection under the Lei nº 13.709/2018 (LGPD). Art. 1 paragraph single authorises international data transfers under LGPD Art. 33 I to all EU member states, the EEA states Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and EU institutions, bodies and agencies, referring to Regulation (EU) 2016/679, EEA Joint Committee Decision 154/2018 and Regulation (EU) 2018/1725. Art. 2 excludes transfers made exclusively for public security, national defence, State security or criminal investigation and prosecution. Art. 3 allows the ANPD to set up cooperation mechanisms with the European Commission and European data protection authorities. Art. 4 requires the ANPD to monitor the EU level of protection on a continuing basis, may request information and carry out periodic assessments, and provides for reassessment within four years of entry into force, taking into account later changes to EU data protection law. Art. 5 states that the decision does not prevent transfers to those countries under the other transfer mechanisms of LGPD Art. 33. Art. 6 sets entry into force on the date of publication. The resolution was adopted by the ANPD Conselho Diretor under LGPD Art. 34 and internal regulations, citing Resolução CD/ANPD nº 19/2024.

thresholds.note: The instrument is an adequacy recognition of the European Union for international data transfers under Lei nº 13.709/2018. It contains no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment of an entity, person, product or facility. The only number tied to a time period is the four-year reassessment in Art. 4 §1, which is a procedural time limit and is not coded as a threshold.
